# 2395. Find Subarrays With Equal Sum

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def findSubarrays(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: bool
        """
        s = set([])
        for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
            t = nums[i] + nums[i + 1]
            if t in s:
                return True
            s.add(t)
        return False
```
